summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of common shares under Regulation D/S and a standard distribution declaration. The company sold 1,806,263 shares for $36.2 million based on NAV, and declared monthly distributions across share classes. No special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is present. The filing is a routine capital raise and distribution notice, not a special-situation event.
